title: File one item with its spec in one import, short title included
lead: A one-item outline passed to `slicer import` takes a `short_title` key, the import skeleton lists every key the parser accepts, and the filing guidance names one-item import as the way to file an item with its fields and spec in one command.
findings_note: outer-session wishlist 2026-10-16, item 7: each filing was add with eight flags, then promote

sections.heading: Why
Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/outline.py`: `short_title` in `KEYS`, carried through `to_dict` and into the item.
- `src/slicer/ops.py`, the import path: set the item's short title from it, with the same validation as `add --short-title`.
- `src/slicer/cli.py` or wherever the skeleton text lives: list `short_title`, `key`, `discovered_from` and `parent` with one line each.
- `slicer ai instructions` (filing) and `AGENTS.md` (Working on the roadmap): "To file one item with its fields and spec, pass `import` a one-item outline; `--dry-run` first."
- `docs/commands.md` (the `import` row), `CHANGELOG.md` under Added.
- `tests/test_outline.py`, `tests/test_import.py`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_Outline_ShortTitleKey_Parsed`
- `test_Import_ShortTitle_SetsItemShortTitle`
- `test_ImportSkeleton_ListsEveryOutlineKey`: every name in `outline.KEYS` appears in the skeleton comment.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Add the key, the import wiring and the skeleton lines.
3. Instructions, AGENTS.md, docs and CHANGELOG; mutation-check (drop the key from `KEYS`; drop one skeleton line).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
